request: Can I get Windsor Castle as a 3D print, 18 cm long?

tallest.why: The Round Tower's flag turret at 85.3 m above the sea, over ground taken as 46 m. The 46 m is the pack's, so this holds the print to the pack.

dimensions.why: The smallest rectangle round the mapped castle.

why: The map has no heights: the Round Tower on its mound, the ranges, the chapel and the walls come from the pack.
